title: Precise OpenAPI composition and fail-closed missing-route coverage

phases.objective: Verify that repository maintenance composes authoritative precise OpenAPI contracts before a read-only missing-route gate that refuses uncontracted runtime routes without rewriting the root contract.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: OpenAPI maintenance regression executes isolated route, registry, allowlist, and root-contract fixtures
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Precise contracts are composed by the authoritative registry sync, uncontracted routes block write/check modes, and openapi.yaml remains byte-identical whenever the gate refuses coverage.
steps: Discover runtime routes from source-bound route files.
Compose registered precise path-item references before coverage evaluation.
Attempt write compatibility mode while one runtime route lacks a precise contract or explicit allowlist ownership.
Verify the gate returns a stable missing_precise_contracts decision and performs no repository mutation.
Add explicit allowlist ownership and verify the same write mode succeeds as a read-only no-op.
Exercise an occupied precise root path and verify the authoritative registry writer fails closed.
assertions: Registry-only precise paths are composed even when route discovery cannot find them.
No generic operation, TODO summary, request schema, response schema, or consequential flag is synthesized.
Blocked write and check modes return non-zero with repository_mutation_performed=false.
The root OpenAPI file remains byte-identical after a blocked write attempt.
Explicit allowlist ownership satisfies coverage without changing the root contract.
An occupied conflicting root path fails closed.

phases.objective: Publish blocked missing-route identities through canonical generated-artifact evidence without exposing secrets or mutating protected branches.
Exercise malformed registry entries, duplicate source ownership, and interrupted precise composition.
Observe fail-closed coverage evidence on representative OpenAPI route additions.
Require precise-contract or explicit allowlist ownership for every protected-branch runtime route.
